backdrop.png.prompt: 16-bit pixel art game background, SNES-era style, crisp hard-edged pixels, limited warm palette. A cozy fantasy tavern interior seen from a side / three-quarter view, wide 16:9 composition, wooden plank floor, stone and timber walls, warm candle and fire light. Clearly separated areas: LEFT third: a row of sturdy wooden workbenches / crafting tables with tools (hammers, tongs, anvil, scrolls, gears) with open floor space in front for six small characters. BACK RIGHT: a long wooden bar counter with a brass hand bell on it, shelves of bottles and barrels behind it, space in front for four characters. RIGHT side: a big stone hearth / fireplace with a glowing fire and two or three cozy armchairs around it, space for four characters. FRONT (bottom of image, foreground): long wooden benches and a table, room for six characters. A wooden door on the far left wall. Empty room: absolutely no people, no characters, no animals, no text, no letters, no signs with writing, no UI.

char-1-work.png.prompt:
Pixel art sprite sheet, 16-bit SNES-style, cute chibi characters about 2.5 heads tall, crisp hard pixel edges, dark 1px outlines, consistent scale and style, no anti-aliasing, no text, no labels, no grid lines. Fully transparent background. Exactly 4 rows and 5 columns, evenly spaced with clear empty gaps between every sprite, every sprite full body and the same size, feet aligned on each row's baseline.
Row 1: a stout dwarf blacksmith with a braided red beard, leather apron and helmet.
Row 2: an elf scholar with long silver hair, pointed ears, blue robe and round glasses.
Row 3: a human ranger with a green hood, brown cloak and quiver.
Row 4: a gnome tinkerer with goggles on her head, purple hair, overalls and a wrench.
The same 5 poses in the same order in every row, left to right:
Column 1 WORK: facing right in side view, swinging a hammer down onto a small work piece / tool, busy working.
Column 2 CALL: facing the viewer, one arm raised high waving excitedly, mouth open as if calling for attention.
Column 3 REST: sitting relaxed on the ground holding a wooden mug of ale, content smile.
Column 4 KO: lying flat on the back knocked out, eyes as X marks, little yellow stars circling above the head.
Column 5 IDLE: standing neutral facing the viewer, arms at the sides.
